title: Omit sitemap dates until content records their modification time
context: The project model records a portfolio year but has no modification-date field. The newly enabled sitemap needs to describe public content without treating a rebuild as a content edit.
options: Fill lastModified with the build time.
Omit lastModified until an accurate content timestamp is recorded.
choice: Include the current public URLs and defer lastModified until the content model supplies a reliable timestamp.
tradeoff: Search engines receive no per-route freshness hint. Section 30's lastModified requirement remains a written deferral.
